source.description: Approved original ink/color/final raster contact sheet plus a scoped six-panel pale-pencil repair sheet replacing only defective Steps 1-5.
source.notes: Original Steps 1-5 were superseded because their first four frames repeated an already closed brush silhouette. A five-column repair sheet was rejected privately for uneven grid gutters; v3 is the approved standard 3x2 repair. The same angled face-free paintbrush persists through all repaired and retained frames.

process_strategy: A primitive map grows into a brush silhouette, uncolored paint bands, details, ink, color, and only a small reinforcement finish.

construction_contract.temporary_guides: Pale handle capsule, ferrule box, bristle trapezoid, paint-swoosh route, highlight ovals, and shadow footprint may soften, but their placement persists.
construction_contract.step_1_boundary: Only pale primitives; no connected finished silhouette, bristle texture, black ink, or marker fill.
construction_contract.step_2_boundary: Only the connected brush silhouette; the paint remains a single guide route.
construction_contract.step_3_boundary: Three uncolored parallel paint bands appear; no black ink or marker fill.

final_elements.name: pale paintbrush construction map
final_elements.description: A handle capsule, ferrule box, bristle trapezoid, one swoosh route, highlight gaps, and a flat shadow footprint establish the tilted pose.

final_elements.name: angled handle ferrule and bristle silhouette
final_elements.description: One face-free paintbrush points from lower left to upper right with a rounded handle, metal ferrule, and wide bristles.

final_elements.name: three parallel rainbow paint bands
final_elements.description: Exactly three established parallel bands leave the bristle edge and curl upward, ending in three round tips.

final_elements.name: bristle texture ferrule seam and four rivet dots
final_elements.description: Long bristle-direction strokes, one ferrule seam, and exactly four small rivet dots complete the hardware detail without adding color.

final_elements.name: two paper highlights and flat shadow
final_elements.description: Two handle highlight gaps and one short flat ground shadow are reserved before ink or marker color.

final_elements.name: imperfect black marker structure
final_elements.description: Thick black felt-tip traces only the established brush, three paint bands, highlights, marks, and shadow.

final_elements.name: coral yellow teal and blue-gray marker fills
final_elements.description: Coral handle and outer band, warm-yellow bristles and middle band, teal inner band, blue-gray ferrule, and navy shadow retain visible marker streaks.

overlap_reservations.background_lines_stop_before: The bristle edge stops at the three reserved paint-band starts, and the flat shadow stops before the handle.
